verdict.rationale: Gladia is an API-first transcription service. Its documentation describes a public API for both real-time and asynchronous transcription, with request parameters such as `model` and `custom_vocabulary_config` and a live-session init call that returns a connectable URL and session id. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: We offer a simple API to get transcription from your audios and videos, in both Real-time and asynchronous ways
end-to-end audio infrastructure to record, transcribe and enrich audio through a single API
Pick a model with `model` in your request. Omit it to use the default: **`solaria-1`**.
The init call returns a connectable URL and a session `id` that you can safely pass to web, iOS, or Android clients without exposing credentials
